The honest bit

Most students do not need more hours. They need someone to notice.

These are the three sentences parents say to us most often in the first meeting — and exactly what we do about each one.

What parents tell us
  • “In class he says he understood. At home he cannot even start the question.”
  • “Doubts keep piling up quietly until the test, and then it is too late.”
  • “We pay every month and still have no idea where she actually stands.”
What we do about it
  • Every concept ends with one solved question and one blank one, done in the room while the teacher watches.
  • Sunday doubt clinic, 9 am to 12 pm. Nothing is allowed to carry into the next week.
  • A written report on the first Saturday of every month, with the actual test sheets attached.
What is included

Six things every batch gets, whatever you pay.

No separate charge for notes, tests or the doubt clinic. The fee on this page is the whole fee.

Batches of eighteen

Small enough that the teacher knows which four students have gone quiet this week, and asks them first.

A test every Saturday

Checked by hand, returned on Monday with corrections written in — not just a number at the top.

Sunday doubt clinic

Three hours, open to every enrolled student. Bring the questions you could not start. No appointment needed.

Monthly parent report

One printed page: attendance, test marks, chapters covered, and one line on what to push at home.

Printed chapter notes

Our own booklets for each chapter, with the board-pattern questions marked. Included in the fee.

Fees in instalments

Pay monthly, quarterly or per term. Tell us what suits the household and we will write it down.

How to join

Three steps, and none of them cost anything.

Admission takes about twenty minutes in total, and most of that is the demo class itself.

1 Message us

Tell us the class and the subjects

One WhatsApp message is enough: “Class 10, science and maths”. We reply with the batch timings that still have seats.

2 Sit a demo

One full class, free, any weekday

Your child sits through a real class with the real batch — not a special performance. Parents are welcome at the back.

3 Start Monday

Pick a batch and a payment plan

Fill one page, take the notes booklet, and begin with the next Monday's chapter. No joining fee beyond registration.

Who teaches

Three teachers. The same three, all year.

Nobody hands your child's batch over to a substitute in November. If a teacher is away, the class is moved, not replaced.

Questions

Asked at almost every admission.

Is the demo class really free?

Yes. One full class in the batch your child would actually join, on any weekday between 4 and 7 pm. Nothing is collected before or after it. Message us on WhatsApp and we will give you two or three slots.

What if we join in the middle of the session?

Common, and fine. You get the printed notes for the chapters already done, and a short catch-up slot on Sunday for the first three weeks. Fees start from the month you join, not from April.

Do you teach only science, or all subjects?

Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics for classes 9 to 12, on CBSE and UP Board syllabus. We do not teach commerce or humanities subjects, and we would rather say so than take the fee.

How will we know whether it is working?

On the first Saturday of every month you get one printed page — attendance, every test mark, chapters covered, and one specific thing to work on at home. If two months pass with no movement, we will tell you that too.

Is there an online option?

Classes are in person at Krishna Nagar. If a student is ill or out of town, that day's board work and practice sheet are sent on WhatsApp the same evening so nothing is missed.

Where exactly are you, and when can we visit?

Second floor, Shree Complex, Krishna Nagar, Mathura 281004 — above the stationery shop, opposite the water tank. Walk in any day between 4 and 7 pm, or call first on +91 84393 05810.
